findings.explanation: Google deprecated Memorystore for Memcached on 2026-01-20; from 2027-02-01 instances can only be created in projects that already have one, and support and the service itself end on 2029-01-31. A freshly published module steers new users onto a dead-end service that also lacks the controls its replacement has (no AUTH/IAM auth, no in-transit encryption, no CMEK), so anything on the authorized network can read and write the cache. No built-in policy covers google_memcache_instance deprecation.
findings.remediation: Position the module for managing existing instances during migration only (README notice added), and point new workloads at Memorystore for Valkey; decide whether to keep publishing the module or mark the registry entry deprecated.
findings.title: Memorystore for Memcached is a deprecated service: no new instances in new projects after 2027-02-01, shut down 2029-01-31

findings.explanation: The zones validation only checks the zone-name shape. Node zones must be in the instance's region, so europe-west1-b with region europe-west2 plans cleanly and the create call fails. Best-fit principle: apply-time correctness.
findings.remediation: Add a lifecycle precondition requiring each zone to start with "<region>-" (a precondition keeps the module on Terraform 1.5 rather than needing 1.9 cross-variable validation).
findings.title: var.zones is not checked against var.region, so a zone from another region fails only at apply

suggested_policies.rationale: Memorystore for Memcached is deprecated (no new instances in new projects from 2027-02-01, shutdown 2029-01-31). This mirrors HLD_GCP_288 for Cloud Functions 1st gen: any google_memcache_instance is on a dead-end service, which the deprecated operator expresses exactly.
suggested_policies.yaml:
id: LOCAL_GCP_001
name: Memorystore for Memcached (google_memcache_instance) is deprecated — migrate to Memorystore for Valkey
principle: patch-management
severity: MEDIUM
rationale: |
  Google deprecated Memorystore for Memcached on 2026-01-20. After 2027-02-01 new
  instances can only be created in projects that already have one, and the service
  shuts down on 2029-01-31. It also has no authentication, no in-transit encryption
  and no CMEK support.
message: |
  google_memcache_instance uses the deprecated Memorystore for Memcached service.
remediation: |
  Migrate to Memorystore for Valkey (google_memorystore_instance) following Google's
  Memcached-to-Valkey migration guide.
resources:
  google_memcache_instance:
    deprecated: true
